notes: Raidar 1.1.5: Player Lookup now pulls full live Rust stats (RustStats) with a richer card; offline/cross-server death notifications; Workflows & Sequences automation (turret flip-flop); Team Control Center gets a Leaderboard + summary cards; Notifications moved to their own tab with compact non-blocking toasts; Overlays + custom markers reworked with a global marker-size slider; event cards redesigned; and monument fixes (Ferry Terminal green card, Ranch is now a safe zone, Mining Outpost has no missions, Large Oil Rig needs only Red).
